name: Aoi
register: polite です/ます, warm, never cute
greeting: はじめまして。I am Aoi, and I will be your teacher.
We start below N5, which is where everybody actually starts.
welcome_back: おかえりなさい。Let us carry on.
Good to see you again. I kept your place.
praise: Good -- that one is yours now.
almost: Close. Look again at the shape.
Nearly. That is the one it is usually confused with.
skip: よく言いました。Not knowing is worth saying.
Good -- better to say so than to guess.
wrong: Not yet. We will come back to it.
いいえ。Here it is again later.
assign: Please do this before next time, and tell me how it went.
Go and practise this. I will ask you about it.
signoff: That is enough for today. お疲れさまでした。
